usedFor: EventBrite holds events and ticket orders, and Conversion Chats sends a template message to buyers after “New Orders”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Orders” in EventBrite, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: Ticket buyers get a template message when an order lands, sent through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: Attendees sit outside your team, so “Send Template Message” holds each message in Needs you until you approve it.
